[Source · 1990]{.type-badge}

**Author** — [Paul A. David](/people/paul-david.qmd)  ·  *American Economic Review* 80(2)

## Why it's here
The original statement of the **reorganization lag**: electricity took roughly forty years
to show up in the productivity statistics, because factories had to be physically and
organizationally rebuilt around it. Every "a general-purpose technology takes time" argument
on this site traces back to this paper.

::: {.pull-source}
"…many features of the so-called productivity paradox will be found to be neither so
unprecedented nor so puzzling as they might otherwise appear."

[— David, 1990]{.attribution}
:::
